scope: Diagnostic observability only. No native run, browser launch, renderer treatment, auth, threshold, resource floor, build, or release.

measurement_path.process_bracket: The existing ps/iostat diagnostic retains positive named otherHost deltas with PID, executable basename, category, and CPU-seconds delta. Ownership and cleanup categories are unchanged. The strict journal writer retains these rows and both start/end times for each process snapshot, the iostat interval, unmatched PID lists, and category totals.
measurement_path.native_stages: The startup-resource-diagnostic report records an ISO timestamp for every existing native stage while retaining lastNativeStage. Browser spawn, panel open, panel settle, screenshot, and exercise-panel entry are separately visible.
measurement_path.backend: After existing command-line, extension-worker, and spawned-profile ownership verification, the diagnostic starts a second connection through connectOwnedCdp to the same owned browser before local_server. That connection independently verifies profile/process ownership and issues exactly one SystemInfo.getInfo when ready. Neither connection nor query is awaited in the startup sequence; each uses the existing five-second CDP deadline. The primary CDP retains its fatal timeout behavior while optional observation failures remain UNKNOWN. Teardown aborts an unfinished observation without waiting and records failedAt; an in-flight response may therefore remain UNKNOWN. The report stores only skiaBackendType, glRenderer, and allowlisted featureStatus values; commandLine is discarded.
measurement_path.ordinary_acceptance: The backend query and report callback are absent unless startup-resource-diagnostic opts in; ordinary native acceptance retains its launch arguments and resource sampling.

D131 adds an actual owned-CDP transport timeout test: a timed-out observation leaves primary commands working, while a required command timeout remains fatal. Backend failure and teardown remain UNKNOWN. Type/format checks are recorded in the final commit report.

invocation_contract.provenance: Use the frozen 240 development artifact only if the current resource guard admits a single bounded diagnostic. Keep the default renderer; no treatment launch is authorized by this source work.
invocation_contract.interpretation: Match journal bracket timestamps against nativeStages. Positive otherHost CPU is observed but does not prove causal independence or Chromium ownership. An absent or UNKNOWN backend cannot support a Graphite treatment decision. Never promote diagnostic output to product acceptance.
